temporal_notes: Larvae collected between August 2013 and June 2014 across three experimental rounds: September-October 2013, November-December 2013, and May-June 2014.
source_text: The study was conducted in Butemba, Kyankwanzi District, mid-western Uganda, between August 2013 and June 2014... Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) larvae were collected from breeding sites in villages around the Health Centre and reared at the Health Centre... A total of 1196 An. gambiae (s.l.) were identified using PCR: 90.4% were found to be An. gambiae (s.s.), and the rest were An. arabiensis.
geocode_source: OSM Nominatim: Butemba, Kibaale, Western Region, Uganda
